channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: 120 drivers fined for using phones on expressway in Vietnam in the past year
item.description: Traffic police have penalized 120 drivers for using mobile phones while driving on the Ho Chi Minh City - Long Thanh - Dau Giay Expressway, located in southern Vietnam, in the past year, warning that the behavior poses a serious crash risk at high speed.

item.title: Bill Gates foundation trust increases stake in Vietnamese jeweler PNJ
item.description: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust bought additional shares in Vietnamese jeweler Phu Nhuan Jewelry JSC (PNJ), raising its stake in the company, according to a company disclosure.

item.title: Death toll from Brazil floods rises to 46; 21 people still missing
item.description: SAO PAULO/JUIZ DE FORA, Brazil -- The death toll from the heavy rains in Brazil's southeastern state of Minas Gerais has risen to 46, according to figures released by the state fire department on Wednesday.

item.title: Bill Gates admits affairs but denies involvement in Epstein crimes
item.description: Bill Gates has admitted making a "huge mistake" in associating with Jeffrey Epstein, telling staff at his charity foundation that he had affairs with two Russian women but denying involvement in the disgraced financier's crimes.

item.title: Charcoal burns overnight as vendors prepare grilled snakehead fish for God of Wealth Day in Ho Chi Minh City
item.description: Many grilled snakehead fish stalls along Tan Ky Tan Quy Street in Ho Chi Minh City have kept their fires burning through the night to meet residents’ demand for buying fish as offerings for the God of Wealth on Thursday, or the 10th day of the first lunar month, known as God of Wealth Day.

item.title: Sun PhuQuoc Airways launches Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City-Da Nang routes
item.description: Sun PhuQuoc Airways, a new Vietnamese carrier under Sun Group, on Thursday launched new routes linking Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City with Da Nang, enhancing air travel options between Vietnam’s two major cities and the central heritage hub.

item.title: Vietnamese brave rain to buy gold on God of Wealth Day
item.description: Vietnamese buyers lined up in the rain in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City early on Thursday to purchase gold for luck on the annual God of Wealth Day, one of the busiest trading days of the year for gold retailers.

item.title: Da Nang launches 24/7 patrols with anti-UAV guns to curb illegal flights
item.description: Da Nang’s military command has ordered round-the-clock surveillance across the city, deploying patrol units armed with anti-UAV guns to crack down on unauthorized drone flights after a string of recent airspace violations disrupted aviation operations.

item.title: Hanoi motorbike taxi driver admits overcharging foreign tourist, issues apology, refund
item.description: Summoned by the police agency of Hoan Kiem Ward in Hanoi on Wednesday, a motorbike taxi driver admitted to overcharging an American tourist VND1 million (US$38.3) for a seven-kilometer ride.

item.title: Op-ed: Vietnam’s 2045 ambition hinges on building enduring domestic strength
item.description: The year 2045 -- marking the 100th anniversary of the founding of Vietnam -- is steadily becoming a strategic symbol in the nation’s development thinking.
